title: omah config
description: Configuration schema for omah dotfile manager

vault_path.description: Path to the vault directory where dotfiles are stored (supports ~ expansion)

os.description: Target operating system. "auto" detects at runtime.

pkg_manager.description: Package manager used when installing dependencies.

name.description: Display name for the dotfile (used as vault subfolder)

source.description: Path to the source file or directory on your machine (supports ~ expansion)

symlink.description: Replace source with a symlink to the vault entry after backup

deps.description: Required binaries — restore checks these before proceeding

install.description: Shell command to run when the check is not met

check.description: Condition that marks the step as done. Supports: bin:<name>, file:<path>, dir:<path>, app:<name>, cmd:<shell>, out:<text>, skip

setup.description: Setup steps to run after restore (e.g. install packages, create dirs)

exclude.description: Glob patterns to skip when backing up a directory (e.g. "*.log", ".git")
